info.title: Paprel Embed API v1
info.description: Versioned subset of the Paprel public API used by @paprel/accounting.

get.description: Returns a comprehensive, flat-mapped registry of the organization's accounts. While this endpoint does not return a nested tree structure, each record includes its primary classification (Asset, Liability, etc.) and relational metadata (Parent ID), making it ideal for high-performance search, filtering, and data-table rendering.

200.description: Get Accounts

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Adds a new account definition to the organization's financial registry. This process assigns the account to a specific classification (Asset, Liability, Equity, etc.) and establishes its position within the ledger hierarchy. Once created, the account becomes available for journal entries and financial reporting.

200.description: Account successfully registered and activated in the ledger

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

200.description: Get Account Tree

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves the standard library of account subtypes. These classifications provide a second-level layer of categorization (e.g., distinguishing 'Petty Cash' from 'Operating Bank Account') and are used to drive specific automated logic for tax mappings and financial statement grouping.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the classification subtype registry

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Registers a new account subtype within the system. This allows for more granular financial categorization beyond standard types. Subtypes created here will immediately become available in account creation forms, enabling precise tax mapping and balance sheet grouping.

200.description: Subtype successfully registered and integrated into the classification engine

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Updates the metadata and classification logic for an existing account subtype. This action allows for the refinement of financial reporting categories without needing to reclassify individual accounts. **Note:** Updating a subtype's primary mapping will immediately reflect across all linked accounts in the Chart of Accounts and on generated financial statements.

200.description: Subtype configuration successfully updated and propagated

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Provides a detailed view of a specific account, including its configuration metadata and real-time financial statistics. This view aggregates current balances, last activity dates, and period-over-period performance metrics, serving as the primary data source for Account Detail 'White Cards' in the dashboard.

200.description: Successfully retrieved account profile with associated statistics

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Updates the configuration of an existing account in the Chart of Accounts. Use this to adjust the account name, internal code, or re-parent it within the ledger hierarchy. **Note:** Changing an account's primary classification (e.g., Asset to Expense) is restricted if the account contains existing journal entries to prevent ledger corruption.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the account to modify

200.description: Account configuration successfully updated and synced

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

delete.description: Permanent removal of an account from the Chart of Accounts. **Safety Restriction:** An account can only be deleted if it has a zero balance and no historical journal entries. If the account has transaction history, consider deactivating it via the Update endpoint instead to preserve the audit trail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the account to be removed

200.description: Account successfully purged from the system registry

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves all high-liquidity accounts, including Bank Accounts (Checking/Savings) and Credit Cards. This endpoint provides specialized financial metadata such as current balances, currency types, and bank-specific identifiers required for cash flow monitoring and statement reconciliation.

200.description: Get Bank Accounts

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of journal headers and their metadata. Supports advanced filtering by date range, account type, and entity relationships, providing a full audit trail of financial transactions within the organization.

200.description: List Journals

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Registers a new double-entry journal transaction into the ledger. This process validates that debits and credits are balanced, assigns a unique transaction hash for the audit trail, and links the entry to the relevant fiscal period.

200.description: Create Journal

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Fetches the full journal entry associated with a specific root business entity (e.g., an Invoice, Payment, or Expense). This provides the underlying double-entry ledger details, including all debits and credits generated by the source document.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Voids one or more journal entries. This process marks the journals as inactive, reverses their financial impact, and preserves the audit trail without deleting the records.

200.description: Void Journal Entries (Batch)

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Fetches a specific journal entry by its unique identifier. Returns the full transaction header along with all associated ledger lines (debits and credits), entity relationships, and audit metadata required for financial reconciliation.

200.description: Get Journal Entry

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Updates an existing journal transaction. This endpoint re-validates double-entry balance requirements, updates the transaction hash for audit traceability, and ensures the modification complies with fiscal period lock constraints.

200.description: Update Journal

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

delete.description: Permanently removes a journal entry from the ledger. **Constraint:** This action is only permitted for 'Draft' (unposted) entries. Once a journal is 'Posted', it cannot be deleted and must be Voided instead to maintain audit integrity.

200.description: Delete Journal

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves a history of bank reconciliation periods. This endpoint provides the audit trail for verified ledger accuracy, including opening/closing balances and status indicators. Essential for identifying discrepancies between internal books and external bank statements to ensure financial integrity.

200.description: List of reconciliation periods retrieved successfully

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Initiates or finalizes a bank reconciliation record. This endpoint maps the user-provided statement balance against the system-calculated book balance to determine discrepancies. Successful submission validates the integrity of the ledger for the specified date range and updates the reconciliation status.

200.description: Reconciliation record created successfully

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves a single bank reconciliation record by its unique identifier. This provides the full audit context, including the calculated ledger balance, the user-entered statement balance, and the resulting discrepancy ('diff').

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation record

200.description: Reconciliation details retrieved successfully

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Modifies an existing bank reconciliation record. Use this to update the closing balance, notes, or transition the status. Updating a record recalculates the discrepancy ('diff') between the statement and ledger, ensuring the audit trail remains accurate before finalization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation record

200.description: Reconciliation record updated and recalculated successfully

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

delete.description: Permanently removes a reconciliation record from the system. This is intended for deleting draft or erroneous entries that have not been finalized. If the reconciliation was already posted, this operation will unlock linked transactions, but unlike 'Void', it may remove the audit history of this specific attempt.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation record

200.description: Reconciliation record permanently deleted

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

409.description: Conflict: Cannot delete a finalized reconciliation; use the 'Void' endpoint instead to preserve audit logs

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Finalizes the reconciliation by updating the record and generating the necessary journal entries to bridge discrepancies. This endpoint automates the transition from ledger balance to bank statement balance, ensuring the general ledger is synchronized. Re-saving will recalculate the difference and update the linked journal records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation record

200.description: Reconciliation confirmed and journals posted successfully

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

put.description: Voids a finalized reconciliation record and unlocks the associated bank transactions for re-editing. This operation may also reverse any linked journal adjustments created during the finalization process. Essential for correcting historical errors while maintaining a clear audit trail of the voided state.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation record

200.description: Reconciliation record successfully voided and transactions unlocked

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

403.description: Forbidden: Cannot void a reconciliation that has been officially closed in a prior fiscal year

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves a detailed list of bank and ledger transactions. This endpoint provides the raw financial data required for reconciliation and P&L reporting, including transaction dates, descriptions, amounts, and categorization status. Supports filtering by date range and account type to facilitate precise audit lookups.

200.description: List of bank transactions retrieved successfully

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Links a bank transaction to a specific ledger entity (Invoice, Bill, or Journal). This action validates the suggested match, updates the 'is_reconciled' status, and ensures the transaction is correctly allocated within the general ledger. Essential for finalizing automated or manual bank feed matching.

200.description: Transaction match confirmed and ledger synchronized

400.description: Invalid match: Amount mismatch or entity already linked

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

404.description: Transaction or Target Entity not found

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Marks one or more bank transactions as 'Ignored'. This prevents them from appearing in reconciliation queues or financial reports. Used for non-business expenses or duplicate entries. A mandatory 'reason' must be provided to maintain an audit-compliant history of why these records were bypassed.

200.description: Transactions successfully excluded and moved to ignored status

400.description: Invalid Request: Missing mandatory exclusion reason

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

403.description: Forbidden: Cannot exclude transactions belonging to another organization

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Executes a complex reconciliation by linking one or more bank transactions to multiple ledger entities (Invoices, Bills, or Credits). This endpoint validates that the total sum of all selected transactions matches the total allocated amount of the target entities, ensuring the ledger remains balanced across batch payments.

200.description: Group match successfully validated and ledger records linked

400.description: Mathematical mismatch: Total transaction sum does not equal total entity allocation

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

422.description: Unprocessable Entity: One or more records are already reconciled or locked

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Reverses the 'Ignored' status for one or more bank transactions. This action reinstates the records into the active reconciliation queue and includes them in financial reporting once again. Use this to correct accidental exclusions or when a previously ignored transaction is identified as a valid business expense.

200.description: Transactions successfully restored to active status

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

403.description: Forbidden: Unauthorized access to specified transaction records

404.description: Not Found: One or more transaction IDs do not exist

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

post.description: Disconnects a bank transaction from its linked ledger entities (Invoices, Bills, or Journal Entries). This action resets the 'is_reconciled' status to false and removes associated mappings, effectively returning the transaction to the 'Unmatched' queue for re-categorization. Essential for correcting matching errors after they have been confirmed.

200.description: Transaction mappings successfully removed and status reset

400.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.

401.description: Unauthorized: JWT Bearer token missing or expired.

404.description: Not Found: Transaction ID or mapping record not found

409.description: Conflict: Cannot revert a transaction that is part of a locked reconciliation period

412.description: Security check failed (Signature or JTI invalid)

500.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.description: Retrieves the full profile of a specific bank transaction, including its ledger mappings and allocation history. This endpoint reveals how an amount is split across different entities (Invoices, Bills, or Expenses), providing the granular audit trail necessary for precise financial reconciliation.
